title: A-grade distribution by class time
description: A scatter plot showing the percentage of students who earned an A in each course versus the time of day that course starts, revealing whether morning, afternoon or evening sections correlate with higher grades.

options.points: Scatter points, one per course, showing the spread of A-grade rates across start times
options.bubble: Bubble chart where point size represents course enrollment, to see if popularity correlates with grades
options.trend: Scatter points with a trend line to see the overall pattern of grades versus start time

options.all: Every course in this term's schedule
options.remaining: Only courses that satisfy the person's unmet degree requirements
options.open: Only sections that still have open seats

origin.request: give me a scatter plot of percentage of students with an A in the class vs time of day
